# Copilot Instructions for DataEditR

## Project Overview

DataEditR is an R/Shiny package that provides an interactive editor for viewing, entering, filtering, and editing data, including tables stored in databases. The grid is a thin htmlwidget around the MIT-licensed Tabulator JavaScript library (vendored in `inst/htmlwidgets/lib/tabulator-6.7.1`). It can be used as a standalone Shiny gadget (`data_edit()`), an RStudio add-in, or composed from individual Shiny modules.

## Architecture

- **Main entry point:** `data_edit()` in `R/data_edit.R` — launches the full editor as a Shiny gadget. It runs through `editr_run_gadget()` and closes through `editr_stop()` so tests can replace both. The RStudio add-in lookup lives in `editr_addin_selection()`.
- **Grid widget:** `R/grid.R` (R side: `editr_grid()`, column definitions, value conversion) and `inst/htmlwidgets/editr_grid.js` (browser side). Nothing outside these two files knows about Tabulator.
- **Edit engine:** the data lives in R as a working copy with stable row ids and column ids. The grid sends *ops* (`update`, `set_col`, `insert_rows`, `delete_rows`, `rename_col`, `insert_col`, `delete_col`, `set_state`); each op returns its own inverse, which gives undo/redo, change tracking, the review panel and database commits.
  - `R/store.R` — editor state, applying ops, undo/redo, views, change detection.
  - `R/editor.R` — preparing data (`editr_prepare()`), processing ops from the grid, the review panel, change counts, the returned data (`editr_result()`).
- **Databases:** `R/backend-db.R` — `db_table()`, primary key detection, loading rows, `db_commit()` (one transaction with optimistic concurrency checks; conflicts raise an `editr_conflict` error) and `rows_*()` code generation.
- **Code generation:** `R/dataCode.R` — `data_code()` produces tidyverse code that reproduces the edits.
- **Shiny modules:** each feature is a `UI`/`Server` pair:
  - `dataEdit` (`R/dataEdit.R`) — the editor (grid, toolbar, review panel, status bar). `dataEditCommit()` and `dataEditChanges()` save and count changes.
  - `dataInput`, `dataSelect`, `dataFilter`, `dataSync`, `dataOutput` — older modules, still exported for use in custom apps.
- **UI helpers:** `R/ui.R` (icons, toolbar buttons, theme, shortcuts dialog), `inst/www/dataeditr.css` and `inst/www/dataeditr.js`.
- **Helpers:** `R/helpers.R` (data templates, binding rows/columns), `R/utilities.R`, `R/style.R` (CSS for the older modules), `R/shiny.R` (Shiny helpers).

## Coding Conventions

- **Function naming:** Use `snake_case` for standalone exported functions (e.g. `data_edit`, `db_table`). Use `camelCase` for Shiny module functions (e.g. `dataEditUI`, `dataEditServer`, `dataEditCommit`).
- **Documentation:** All exported functions must have roxygen2 documentation (`#'` comments). Internal helper functions use `@noRd` to suppress manual page generation.
- **Section headers:** Use comment banners like `## SECTION NAME ---` to delineate sections within R files.
- **Shiny modules:** Follow the standard `moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) { ... })` pattern. UI functions take `id` as their first argument and use `NS(id)` for namespacing.
- **Imports:** Declare imports via roxygen2 `@importFrom` tags or call functions with `pkg::fun()`. Do not use `library()` or `require()` inside package code. The `NAMESPACE` file is auto-generated by roxygen2 — never edit it by hand.
- **ASCII only:** Keep R sources ASCII. Text that needs symbols (e.g. arrows, multiplication signs) is sent to the browser as HTML entities.

## Dependencies

Key dependencies (declared in `DESCRIPTION`):
- `shiny` (>= 1.7.0), `bslib` (>= 0.5.0, Bootstrap 5), `shinyjs`, `htmlwidgets`, `htmltools`, `rstudioapi`
- Suggested: `DBI`, `dbplyr`, `dplyr`, `RSQLite` (databases), `tibble`, `data.table`, `testthat`, `withr`, `jsonlite`, `knitr`, `rmarkdown`

## Building and Checking

- Run `R CMD check` or `devtools::check()` to validate the package.
- The GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/check-standard.yaml`) runs `rcmdcheck` with `--no-manual --as-cran` on multiple OS/R version combinations.
- Regenerate documentation with `devtools::document()` (or `roxygen2::roxygenise()`). This updates `NAMESPACE` and the `man/` directory.
- Tests use `testthat` (edition 3) under `tests/testthat/`. Shiny code is tested with `shiny::testServer()`; `mock_gadget()` in `helper.R` replaces the gadget so `data_edit()` can be driven end to end. Keep line coverage above 95% (`covr::package_coverage()`).
- Browser tests of the real editor (headless Chrome) live in `tools/e2e`; documentation screenshots (`tools/docs/run.sh`) and animations (`tools/docs/gifs.sh`) are generated by `tools/docs` and the logo by `tools/logo`. `tools/` is excluded from the package build.
- Rebuild the website in `docs/` with `Rscript tools/docs/build_site.R`, which also fixes the MathJax path written by Debian-packaged pkgdown.

## Important Notes

- Do not use dots (`.`) in Shiny input/output IDs (e.g. avoid `Sepal.Width` as an ID).
- Row names are shown in a frozen first column so that they can be edited.
- Column inputs (`col_options`) are normalised by `col_option_spec()` and columns converted by `col_option_convert()` in `R/grid.R`. Typed and pasted values are normalised and checked in the browser (`normalizeValue()` and `invalidReason()` in `editr_grid.js`, which also parses spreadsheet clipboard text); R only accepts complete ISO dates (`parse_date_strict()`).
- Bundled third-party code and its licences are listed in `inst/COPYRIGHTS`; update it (and `Authors@R`) when adding any.
- Edits to filtered rows or hidden columns apply directly to the full data (views are id sets), so no synchronisation step is needed.
- Filtering happens in the browser: header filters, summary picks (`grid.picks`) and the rows of the filter dialog (`grid.conditions`, see "filter dialog" in `editr_grid.js`; the markup is `editr_filter_dialog()`). `dataFilter` is the legacy module.
- Screenshots for the vignettes live in `vignettes/images` (excluded from the build); vignettes fall back to raw GitHub URLs on `master` when the files are missing.
- The `NAMESPACE` file is auto-generated by roxygen2. Never edit it manually.
